title: Trading the CPI Report: What You Need to Know
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Headline expected 3.4%->3.6% and core 2.4%->2.5%; a hotter print would raise odds of a hike at the Fed meeting in ~2 weeks (77% pause priced).

notes: No directional call: says wait and react to CPI, beginners should just watch. QQQ quoted 762 high to ~740 low (-3.11%).
